historical_record.description: A two-family dwelling stood at the front of the lot.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition of a one-story single-family dwelling at 1517 Irving Street.

The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved the new construction of a four-story, three-family residential structure at 1517 Irving Street, with the stair penthouse removed and replaced with an open stair.
